results.title: Alliance Finance supports Marie Stopes in procuring hormone analyser
results.description: Alliance Finance PLC has extended financial support to Marie Stopes Clinic Society to procure a hormone analyser that will strengthen reproductive healthcare services in Bangladesh. Alliance Finance Chief Executive Officer Kanti Kumar Saha recently handed over a cheque to Marie Stopes Bangladesh Board of Directors Chairperson Dr Yasmin H Ahmed in a ceremony at the finance company's corporate office in Dhaka, according to a press release.
